text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a pretty sharp latency cliff when fused RoPE + ALiBi land on the paged-attention path. p50 is fine but p95 jumps ~3x around seq_len=1024 on Dedicated. Repro'd on two different GPU types. Not seeing this on the pure FlashAttention path.

aj: Which bench command / config? model, rotary dim, batch sizes?

maria: Paste of the exact run we used:
```
run_bench --model=llama-13b --kernels=fused_flash_rope --seqs=512,1024,1536 --batches=1,4 --iters=200
export KERNEL_FUSE_ROPE=1
export PAGE_ATTENTION=1
export ROTARY_SCALE=linear
```
Results (median of 3 runs):
- seq=512 batch=1 p50=22ms p95=48ms
- seq=1024 batch=1 p50=40ms p95=160ms
- seq=1536 batch=1 p50=43ms p95=170ms
Also noticed KV cache hit ratio drops ~12% at 1024 and there's a spike in memcpy/eviction ops.

devon: Quick nvprof / trace snippet from the failing run: the attention kernel itself doesn't look slower for short calls, but we get a large number of small kernel launches + an explicit eviction path calling into the host. Cutting paste: 
```
[  TIMESTAMP ] AttnKernel_fused_rope    0.03ms  -> 80.12ms  (seq=1024)
[  TIMESTAMP ] KVCache::evict_batch   90.3ms
[  TIMESTAMP ] memcpy H2D (kv slab)   120ms
```
So the time is dominated by the eviction / copy path that trips when paged-attention decides to remap pages for larger rotary offsets. Looks like the fused RoPE kernel selection toggles a code path that invalidates prefetched KV pages.

bench-bot: CI benchmark 1798765432-1: perf-regression detected — p95 +150ms vs baseline. Flagged as reg-critical.

kevin: Possible short-term mitigations: 1) disable paged fallback for fused_rope when seq>768 (PAGED_ATTENTION=0) 2) reduce prefetch window / backoff KV_PREFETCH=0. We should also guard kernel-selection: don't pick fused_rope if ROTARY_SCALE != 1 or if predicted_eviction_rate > threshold.

maria: Agreed. I'll open a small PR to add a heuristic guard in kernel_selector and a config flag to force no-prefetch for fused_rope. Assigning @devon to hook into the eviction trace so we can avoid the memcpy storm. Also will add a microbench to CI that sweeps seq 512..1536 for p95 regressions.

aj: Good plan. Short-term: ops can toggle KERNEL_FUSE_ROPE=0 on the problematic Dedicated pool to drop latency until we ship the fix. Can someone add that to the incident playbook?

maria: Will do. Adding notes to the playbook and will ping infra for rollout of the env toggle. Thanks y'all — root cause triage assigned to devon, patch + CI microbench in next 24h. :thumbsup:
